lines.text: A @jogger runs past far behind @maya_front as she ties her laces on a park bench.

new_beats.text: Everyone else is already moving. You just have to start.

writes.note: I added a short VO beat that sets her quiet start against the runner behind her.

reply.rationale: The words stay as they are; one brief VO beat fits the shot's short length and avoids naming anything outside the refs.
